about: One list of hook events for every host. The commands are the brain's own scripts; a host file only triggers them (SMART-RULE-0007). Regenerate .claude/settings.json with: hooks.py host-settings

events.note: syncs origin without merging and hears upstream on the skill-exchange cadence (SMART-RULE-0034, SMART-RULE-0032), within about 20 seconds; says nothing when all is current, so a light session pays no tokens (the reason it was held back on 28 September 2026)
the same as session start, for a resumed thread
fires only when a context is compacted, never on a light session, so the held-back reason of the session hooks does not apply; writes the compaction marker (trial of an amendment to SMART-RULE-0019)
the compacted thread reloads the contract and rules and writes the missed handover checkpoint before it dispatches anything (trial of an amendment to SMART-RULE-0019)
